_comment: Robot vertical collision envelope for the Atlas3R 3D occupancy field. The VoxelOccupancyGrid3D is bounded to [floor, floor + collision_height_m + margin_m] along the floor axis; resolution is spent only inside this envelope (the robot never collides with the ceiling). Units are meters. Defaults model a standard floor-cleaning robot. The last fields are the candidate occupancy-estimation policy (applied ONLY to the monocular candidate, never the measured GT): occupancy_support_height_m propagates occupancy DOWNWARD within the band by up to this height into UNKNOWN space below a CONFIDENT obstacle (occupied hit count >= occupancy_support_min_count) -- the honest gravity/support prior that a detected obstacle rests on the floor. free_carve_margin_m (directional downward free-carve truncation) and occupancy_close_voxels are available levers, left OFF here because they trade per-class agreement; see docs/band_obstacle_recall_evidence.md.
